$comment: Database authority of every runtime identity (WALLET-NATIVE-001, ADR-061 §2). PostgreSQL privilege is the authority; application_name (0144) is detection. tools/db-authority.mjs generates db/authority/runtime-authority.sql from this file and fails the build when the SQL, the financial-table list in 0144, or a service's own write footprint disagree with it.

not_financial_money_tables.transaction_proofs: receipt evidence about a completed movement; its financial facts are immutable (0125)
not_financial_money_tables.disputes: case workflow; any restitution moves money through refunds, which are guarded
not_financial_money_tables.payment_requests: an intent to be paid; nothing moves until a guarded payment exists
not_financial_money_tables.consumer_pay_links: an intent to be paid; nothing moves until a guarded payment exists
not_financial_money_tables.qr_codes: a payment interface; nothing moves until a guarded payment exists
not_financial_money_tables.velocity_counters: risk counters; they limit movements, they are not movements
not_financial_money_tables.sandbox_test_fundings: Sandbox quota and idempotency reservations; Core posts the credit
not_financial_money_tables.acquiring_reconciliation_items: reconciliation evidence: detects a mismatch, never corrects the ledger
not_financial_money_tables.reconciliation_attempts: reconciliation evidence: detects a mismatch, never corrects the ledger

financial_write_routines.public.create_primary_wallet_account: trigger on wallets (Core-written): creates the PRIMARY wallet account; SECURITY INVOKER, so it writes only with the privileges of the statement that fired it

bl_core_runtime.purpose: Banzami Core: the only runtime identity with write authority over financial state.

bl_gateway_runtime.purpose: Public API gateway, webhook delivery, realtime, proofs, Business onboarding. Calls Core for every financial operation.

implied_by_triggers.public.merchants: merchant_compliance_projects_verified (0122) updates merchants.verified when the gateway writes merchant_compliance

bl_public_api_runtime.purpose: Consumer API and Sandbox test payers. Calls Core for every financial operation.

bl_developer_api_runtime.purpose: Developer Console, accounts and the single key authority (ADR-046). Calls Core for every financial operation.

bl_admin_api_runtime.purpose: BANZADMIN operator API: operator accounts, KYC review, compliance cases, platform settings. Calls Core for every financial operation.

bl_app_runtime.purpose: Operator tooling on the Sandbox host (fixture sweeps, residue retirement, read-only harness queries). Mounted into no container; its password lives only in the root-only secrets directory. No financial write authority.

not_runtime.bl_schema_owner: NOLOGIN owner of every migrated object. Assumed only by bl_migration.
not_runtime.bl_migration: Short-lived migration login (CONNECTION LIMIT, VALID UNTIL), recreated per controlled migration; credential mounted into the migration executor only.
not_runtime.bl_control_plane: Read-only control-plane login (two SELECT grants); mounted into no service.
not_runtime.sbadmin: Cluster superuser; credential mounted into the postgres container and the operator's migration/bootstrap containers only.
